decisions.reason: Q2 uses "unverified status", a direct synonym of the answer label "untested", and Q1 "before it was examined" also hints it (near-synonym leak).
decisions.suggested_fix: Ask without a testing/verification synonym, e.g. "What was notable about the preservative Sarah Gleeson found in cornflakes in 1915, regarding its safety vetting?" or accept the label as inherently non-askable and drop the question.
